title: Man pepper-sprayed on bus dies
article: A 32-year-old man who was pepper-sprayed during a confrontation on a Toronto bus has died.
Jasen Drnasin succumbed shortly before 3 p.m. Monday at the Humber River Regional Hospital.

The Croatian native was involved in an altercation on Nov. 12 with Toronto Transit Commission special constables and Toronto police officers on a bus in the Eglinton Avenue West and Royal York Road area.
After he was sprayed with pepper foam, he went into medical distress and was transported to hospital in critical condition with severe brain swelling.
Born in Split, Croatia, Drnasin was one of the first Croatians to graduate from West Point, the prestigious military academy in New York State, according to relatives.
The province's Special Investigations Unit will continue to probe the extent of police involvement.
